_comment: Hand-kept protest data. The calendar feeds (MAPA, Turn Purple 2 Blue, XR Boston) are read automatically on every run; this file holds (1) the sources that must be reviewed by hand, with the date each was checked, and (2) weekly demonstrations kept as a backup because the MAPA feed shows each weekly series only once. Update reviewed_on and each checked_on after every hand review.

events.name: Bearing Witness @ ICE
events.venue: 1000 District Ave, outside the ICE New England office
events.attendance: Small standing vigil, typically a few dozen to a few hundred people. Density well under 2 people per m². Weekly Wednesday schedule confirmed by the MAPA calendar on Nov 4; organizers may cancel for severe weather.

events.name: Justice 4 All Thursdays
events.venue: 1000 District Ave, along District Ave near the ICE office
events.attendance: Standing demonstration with signs along District Ave, with an optional short march to Mall Rd. Attendance not published; organizers say they do not block the entrance or traffic. Rated Low provisionally.

events.name: No Fear with Street Theater
events.venue: Burlington Mall Rd at District Ave, two blocks from the ICE office
events.attendance: Weekly Saturday protest with street theater. Attendance not published. Rated Low provisionally; may be cancelled in poor weather.
